project: Terra Santa Casa 1 - Plan to 3D House
main_prompt: Create a single continuous architectural transformation video in which the exact received floor plan gradually becomes a complete conceptual 3D house. Preserve the long horizontal linear footprint, the relative position of walls, room divisions, openings, terraces and planted areas. Do not invent a second floor, extra wings or a different footprint. Use ivory walls, burnt-orange structural edges, warm wood, graphite shadows, translucent blue glazing and subtle soft-pink glazing accents. Begin with a clean architectural plan, raise the slab and walls, add openings and materials, then finish with the complete house in a landscaped condominium.

camera.movement: start low and oblique near the ground, looking slightly upward, then rise and pull back into a high three-quarter aerial view showing the complete house
camera.motion: slow, stable, cinematic, single continuous move, no cuts

environment: beautiful contemporary condominium under development, warm sandy soil, soft concrete paths, restrained tropical planting, distant low houses, warm early-morning sunlight and long soft shadows

scroll_behavior.progress_mapping: video time maps linearly to scroll progress from 0 to 100 percent

negative_prompt: generic luxury villa, second floor, extra wings, changing footprint, random room layout, warped walls, melting geometry, duplicated windows, floating furniture, camera cuts, fisheye lens, pool, cars, people, text, labels, dimensions, logo, watermark, unstable architecture
